text:
kevin: quick thread 1: we need a final decision on what to surface in the autofallback audit card.

maya: +1. current list: fallback_code only. propose: fallback_reason (enum+text), policy_snapshot_id, policy_version_ts, decision_id, degrade_mode, latency_ms, target_model, fallback_model, sampled_evidence_hash, sampling_rate.

li: for UI clarity, show a one-line summary: "Auto-fallback: latency (1250ms) -> redwood-3b" and a chevron to expand. expansion shows policy_snapshot_id + small evidence.

kevin: legal wants retention defaults: 90d but allow org override to 365d via support request. note: retention changes must be audited.

maya: security: redact PII and strip auth headers. we should also include sampled_request_hash so audits can correlate without storing raw prompt.

sre-bot: ALERT: ensure opt-in webhook for full traces requires SOC review.

li: API endpoints: GET /admin/decisions/{id} and GET /admin/decisions?org=..&from=..&to=..; add X-Audit-Access header and pagination.

kevin: also add field error_class: infra|model|rate_limit; and include signal_summary: e.g., "latency>1000ms" or "model_err:502".

maya: cap sampled_evidence at 10KB compressed. include signed_snapshot_token so UI can verify snapshot authenticity when comparing diffs.

li: tiny UX ask: badge color for degrade_mode: quiet=muted, failover=red, canary=amber.

kevin: action items: @maya produce redaction + sampling rules; @li wire admin endpoints + pagination; @kevin write retention proposal and policy for auditability.

maya: i'll push redaction schema tomorrow.

li: i'll stub endpoints this sprint.

kevin: thanks team, will pair on the console card after.
